title: Aspire Pixo Replacement Vape Pods - 2 Pods
description: Designed to perfectly complement the Aspire Pixo Pod Kit, the Aspire Pixo Replacement Pods offer versatility and convenience in one handy 2-pack. Each pod comes with a built-in mesh coil for enhanced flavour and vapour production. Available in three resistances—0.4ohm, 0.6ohm, and 1.0ohm—these pods cater to both mouth-to-lung (MTL) and restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) vaping styles. The 0.4ohm pod delivers a slightly warmer, denser vape with more vapour, making it ideal for sub-ohm or direct-to-lung vaping. The 0.6ohm pod provides a perfect balance between vapour and flavour, ideal for nicotine salt or freebase e-liquids. For those who prefer a smooth, MTL draw with a higher resistance, the 1.0ohm pod ensures a satisfying hit with excellent flavour production. Each pod has a 2ml e-liquid capacity (TPD version) and features an easy side-fill system for quick and mess-free refills. The adjustable airflow on the Pixo Pod Kit allows for further fine-tuning of your vaping experience. We Recommend using the following E-Liquid with these pods Aspire Pixo Replacement Pods - 0.4ohm use High VG (Sub-Ohm) E-Liquid Aspire Pixo Replacement Pods - 0.6ohm use Nic Salt E-Liquid Aspier Pixo Replacement Pods - 1.0ohm use High PG, 50/50 and Nic Salt E-Liquid Aspier Pixo Replacement Pods - 1.2ohm use High PG, 50/50 and Nic Salt E-Liquid Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
